description: Manifest of workflows this repo is allowed to deploy. deploy_n8n_workflows_remote.py reads this list rather than deploying every file under n8n/, so adding a workflow to the deploy path is always a deliberate, reviewable edit.

workflows.notes: Read-only Plaid connectivity check. Must stay inactive until a human reviews a manual sandbox test run.
Webhook for the Link launcher page. Creates a short-lived link_token only. Requires the 'Finance Webhook Signing Secret' and 'Plaid Sandbox Custom Auth' credentials.

Webhook that exchanges a public_token for an access_token and returns it to the caller for the user to store securely. n8n Community-compatible (no env vars, no Public API). Requires the 'Finance Webhook Signing Secret' and 'Plaid Sandbox Custom Auth' credentials.

Manual-trigger workflow that calls /transactions/sync for a linked item and emits a redacted summary (counts, date range, absolute total) only. Binds to a per-item Custom Auth credential ('Plaid Sandbox Item 1') holding client_id/secret headers plus the access_token body field. Inactive by default.

Manual-trigger workflow: syncs transactions, minimizes to date/amount/merchant/category (drops identifiers), persists minimized set to /automation/finance on atlas, and sends the minimized set to Claude for categorization + advisory recommendations. Requires 'Plaid Sandbox Item 1' and 'Anthropic API Key' (Name=x-api-key) credentials. Transmits minimized transaction data to the Anthropic API by design. Inactive by default.
